App.name: FitLabs
App.description: Weekly gym workouts generated for you

SignIn.sub: Sign in to plan your training week.

SignIn.invite: Accounts are created by invitation only.

errors.missingPassword: Enter your password, or use a magic link.

about.title: About you
about.sub: We use this to set starting weights. Only you can see it.
about.name: Name

beginner.label: Beginner
beginner.hint: Less than a year of regular training

goal.title: What's your main goal?
goal.sub: Pick one. You can change it any time.

strength.label: Strength
strength.hint: Lift heavier. Lower reps, longer rest.

muscle.label: Build muscle
muscle.hint: More volume, moderate weight, steady progress.

fat.label: Fat loss
fat.hint: Keep strength, add circuits and conditioning.

general.label: General fitness
general.hint: Feel strong and move well. Balanced mix.

schedule.title: When do you train?
schedule.sub: Tap days, then pick a focus for each.
schedule.daysPerWeek: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} / week

rules.title: Your rules
rules.sub: Every plan we build will follow these.

noWarmup.label: I don't warm up
noWarmup.hint: Skip warm-up sets — go straight to working weight

absFinisher.label: Always finish with abs
absFinisher.hint: Add 1–2 core exercises at the end of every session

rules.notesPlaceholder: e.g. Bad left knee — no jumping. Keep Fridays under 40 min.

equipment.title: What does your gym have?
equipment.sub: We'll only plan exercises you can do.
